title: LANGUAGE SPECIFIC KNOWLEDGE: DO MODELS KNOW BETTER IN X THAN IN ENGLISH?

bias_targets.methodology: Comparing model reasoning and question-answering accuracy across 16 different input languages for semantically equivalent queries to demonstrate that models possess language-specific knowledge and do not equally align all languages in their latent space.

Evaluating classification accuracy on culturally-grounded multiple-choice datasets (CultureAtlas, BLEnD, Social IQa) to measure how well models understand diverse societal norms and whether they exhibit Western or English-centric biases in commonsense reasoning.
